name: Treadmill Walking
steps: Straddle or step onto the stopped treadmill belt, attach the safety clip, and start the belt at a comfortable flat walking pace.
Stand tall with your gaze forward, shoulders relaxed, and arms swinging naturally opposite your legs.
Walk smoothly in a continuous heel-to-toe alternating stride near the center of the belt.
Maintain an even cadence for your target distance or duration, then slow the belt completely before stepping off.
tips: Avoid gripping the handrails while walking so your posture and natural arm swing stay unimpeded.
Stay centered near the middle of the belt without crowding the front console or drifting toward the rear.
